title: AI Specialist – Claude AI | Architecture & Interior Design
description:
We are looking for an **AI Specialist with strong expertise in Claude AI and AI\-assisted Architecture \& Interior Design workflows**. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between **Artificial Intelligence and architectural/interior design processes**, helping our team use AI to improve concept development, documentation, visualization, research, presentations, and day\-to\-day productivity.

The candidate should understand both **AI tools and the practical requirements of Architecture and Interior Design** and be capable of developing structured AI workflows using Claude AI.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement **Claude AI workflows** for architecture and interior design projects.
* Create advanced prompts, reusable templates, and AI\-assisted processes for:
* Concept development
* Design briefs
* Space planning
* Material and finish selection
* Design narratives
* Client presentations
* Project documentation
* BOQ/specification support
* Design research
* Project correspondence
* Use Claude AI to analyze architectural drawings, design information, project requirements, specifications, and other relevant documentation.
* Build **custom AI assistants, knowledge bases, and structured prompt systems** for architecture and interior design teams.
* Help architects and interior designers integrate AI into their existing workflows.
* Develop workflows connecting Claude AI with tools such as **AutoCAD, SketchUp, 3ds Max, Adobe Creative Suite, Excel, Notion, and other AEC software**, where appropriate.
* Assist in generating and refining design concepts, mood boards, material palettes, furniture concepts, and presentation content using AI\-supported workflows.
* Research emerging AI tools relevant to **Architecture, Interior Design, BIM, visualization, documentation, and project management**.
* Create SOPs and training materials for the internal team.
* Train architects, interior designers, project managers, and other staff on effective use of AI.
* Evaluate AI\-generated outputs for accuracy, design relevance, consistency, and usability.
* Maintain confidentiality of project information and establish appropriate AI usage practices.
* Continuously experiment with new AI models, tools, plugins, and automation opportunities.

**Required Skills**

* Strong practical knowledge of **Claude AI / Anthropic Claude**.
* Excellent **prompt engineering** and AI workflow design skills.
* Understanding of **Architecture and/or Interior Design processes**.
* Ability to understand architectural drawings, floor plans, elevations, sections, material specifications, and design concepts.
* Experience working with AI tools for design, visualization, documentation, or automation.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Ability to convert business/design requirements into structured AI workflows.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to verify AI\-generated information.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Application Engineering, Principal Engineer
description:
New Delhi, National Capital Territory of Delhi, India


**Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 18878 **Date posted** 09/21/2026  
**We Are**


At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self\-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high\-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.

**You Are**


You are a DDR/LPDDR Controller System Architecture Specialist who can work directly with customer architects to close real system\-level memory subsystem design decisions.


You are comfortable discussing SoC integration, memory subsystem architecture, controller configuration, performance optimization, power management, validation, and interoperability topics. You can help customers evaluate technical trade\-offs and guide them toward practical architecture decisions.


This is a customer\-facing technical role. You will help customers integrate DDR/LPDDR controller IP into complex SoCs, identify key requirements or gaps, and translate customer feedback into actionable input for Synopsys Product Management, R\&D, and roadmap planning.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Own the technical architecture engagement for DDR/LPDDR controller IP with strategic customers, from early platform requirements through architecture closure and initial deployment readiness.
* Work with customer architects and engineering teams to define suitable DDR/LPDDR memory subsystem configurations for advanced SoC platforms.
* Analyze system\-level trade\-offs related to memory bandwidth, latency, power efficiency, quality of service, reliability, validation, and scalability.
* Translate customer platform requirements and integration constraints into clear feedback for Synopsys Product Management, R\&D, and roadmap planning.
* Support technical closure of design wins by providing architecture guidance, configuration recommendations and competitive positioning.
* Develop reusable technical material, application notes, and customer\-facing guidance based on real engagement experience.
* Train FAEs and customer teams on DDR/LPDDR architecture, memory subsystem integration, performance tuning, validation expectations, and deployment best practices.

**The Impact You Will Have**

* Improve the quality of DDR/LPDDR design wins by ensuring customer memory architectures are technically sound before commitment.
* Strengthen Synopsys DDR/LPDDR roadmap by feeding real customer memory subsystem requirements into product planning and R\&D execution.
* Reduce customer integration risk by identifying architecture, performance, power, validation, and bring\-up issues early.
* Help establish Synopsys as a trusted technical partner for next\-generation AI, HPC, mobile, automotive, networking, and edge computing platforms.
**What You’ll Need**

* Bachelors and/or Masters Degree in Electrical and/or Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science
* 5\+ years of experience in DDR/LPDDR architecture, memory subsystem design, SoC integration, silicon validation, systems engineering, applications engineering, or customer\-facing technical leadership.
* Solid understanding of DDR and/or LPDDR controller IP, including memory architecture concepts, controller configuration, scheduling, quality of service, power management, training, validation, or system integration.
* Good system\-level understanding of SoC integration and ability to reason through memory bandwidth, latency, power efficiency, quality of service, reliability, validation, and software/firmware trade\-offs.
* Experience engaging directly with customer architects, design teams, validation teams, and technical decision\-makers.
* Ability to translate ambiguous customer requirements into clear technical recommendations, product feedback, and closure plans.
* Strong technical communication skills, including clear written analysis, structured trade\-off explanation, and ability to align customer, sales, product, and engineering teams.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Linux, firmware bring\-up, or software\-driven debug of DDR/LPDDR subsystems.
* Familiarity with advanced SoC architectures used in AI, HPC, automotive, mobile, networking, or compute platforms.
* Experience with memory performance analysis, traffic modeling, quality\-of\-service management, memory hierarchy optimization, or system\-level benchmarking.
* Knowledge of advanced topics such as DDR5, LPDDR5X, LPDDR6, memory training algorithms, RAS features, chiplet\-based memory architectures, or AI memory bandwidth optimization.

**The Team You’ll be a Part Of**


You will be part of our IP high\-performance computing applications engineering team, a group of dedicated professionals who are passionate about technology and innovation. The team focuses on helping customers integrate more capabilities into SoCs faster, working collaboratively across geographic and organizational boundaries to drive revenue growth and accelerate business closure.

**Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

**Inclusion and Diversity**


Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: Site Supervisor
description:
We are seeking a skilled and experienced Site Supervisor to join our team. The Site Supervisor will play a crucial role in overseeing the construction process, ensuring that projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. This role requires strong leadership abilities, excellent communication skills, and a keen attention to detail.

**Responsibilities:**

\- Manage on\-site construction activities to ensure adherence to design specifications, timelines, and budget constraints.

\- Collaborate with architects, interior designers, and contractors to resolve any design or construction issues that may arise during the project.

\- Conduct regular site inspections to monitor progress, quality of workmanship, and compliance with safety regulations.

\- Review and interpret architectural drawings, plans, and specifications to guide construction activities.

\- Coordinate with suppliers, subcontractors, and vendors to procure materials and equipment as needed.

\- Document project progress, including daily reports, photographs, and as\-built drawings.

\- Communicate effectively with clients to address concerns, provide updates, and obtain approvals as required.

**Requirements:**

\- Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Interior Design, or related field.

\- Proven experience of 2\-5 years in site supervision or construction management within the architectural or interior design industry.

\- Strong knowledge of construction techniques, building codes, and regulations.

\- Proficiency in reading and interpreting architectural drawings and blueprints.

\- Excellent communication, leadership, and problem\-solving skills.

\- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.

\- Proficiency in relevant software and tools.

\- Detail\-oriented mindset with a focus on quality and precision.

\- Effective communication skills, both verbal and written.

\- Ability to work independently and make decisions confidently.

\- Proficiency in relevant software and tools for project management and documentation.

**Benefits:**

\- Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

\- Opportunities for career growth and professional development.

\- Collaborative and supportive work environment with a diverse team of professionals.

\- Chance to contribute to exciting and innovative architectural projects that make a difference in communities.

title: Technical Architect
company: HiringPulse – A Company of VDOIT Technologies Limited
description:
**About the Role**

Vdoit is looking for an experienced and hands\-on **Technical Architect – AI** to lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and high\-performance technology solutions.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in **AI/ML, Generative AI, software architecture, cloud technologies, system design, APIs, microservices, and modern application development**. The candidate will work closely with engineering, product, DevOps, and business teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and define scalable, secure, and high\-performance application architectures.
* Lead technical architecture and solution design for new and existing products.
* Evaluate and implement **AI/ML and Generative AI** capabilities into business applications.
* Design AI solutions using **LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, AI APIs, and prompt engineering**.
* Work closely with product managers, developers, DevOps teams, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and define technical solutions.
* Create architecture documents, technical specifications, system diagrams, and technology roadmaps.
* Define and enforce best practices related to coding, architecture, security, scalability, performance, and maintainability.
* Design and integrate **REST APIs, microservices, third\-party APIs, and cloud services**.
* Identify technical risks and recommend appropriate architectural solutions.
* Conduct technical reviews and mentor senior developers and engineering teams.
* Research emerging technologies and recommend tools and frameworks suitable for Vdoit's technology ecosystem.
* Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, secure, reliable, and cost\-effective.
* Troubleshoot complex technical and architectural challenges and provide long\-term solutions.

**Required Technical Skills**

* **5–10 years of experience** in software development, solution architecture, or technical architecture.
* Strong understanding of **System Design and Software Architecture**.
* Hands\-on experience with one or more programming languages such as **Python, Java, Node.js, .NET, or similar**.
* Strong understanding of **AI/ML and Generative AI** concepts.
* Hands\-on experience with **LLMs, OpenAI/Gemini/Claude or similar AI APIs, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and prompt engineering**.
* Strong knowledge of **REST APIs, microservices, event\-driven architecture, and distributed systems**.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as **AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud**.
* Good knowledge of databases such as **PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis**, or equivalent.
* Understanding of **Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Git, and DevOps practices**.
* Strong understanding of **application security, authentication, authorization, and data protection**.
* Experience integrating third\-party services and APIs.

**Good to Have**

* Experience building **AI\-powered enterprise applications**.
* Experience with **LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, vector databases**, or similar AI frameworks.
* Knowledge of **AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI**, or equivalent AI platforms.
* Experience with **AI agents, tool calling, function calling, or multi\-agent architectures**.
* Experience designing **high\-availability and highly scalable systems**.
* Knowledge of **cloud\-native and serverless architectures**.
* Experience working in **Agile/Scrum** environments.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Strong leadership, collaboration, and mentoring capabilities.
* Ability to take ownership of architecture and technical decisions.
* Strong interest in emerging technologies, particularly **AI and Generative AI**.

**Education**

* Bachelor's/Master's degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering**, or a related field is preferred.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work on **AI\-driven and next\-generation technology solutions**.
* Exposure to modern **cloud, software architecture, and Generative AI technologies**.
* Opportunity to work with a collaborative and innovative technology team.
* Career growth and leadership opportunities.

Pay: ₹1,000,000\.00 \- ₹1,200,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Provident Fund
